summary: In implementing its strategy, the manager employs a methodology similar the MerQube Hedged Premium Income Index (the “MQKHPI”). The MQKHPI is designed to be 100% invested in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) while selling 1-Month call options and purchasing 3-Month put options on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY). The MQKHPI aims to generate income from selling call spreads while providing downside protection through the purchase of put spreads, maintaining exposure to the U.S. large-cap equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
